newsitem.title: UK: "Tommy" to close despite award nominations.
newsitem.headline: "Tommy" to close despite award nominations.

text.p: Tommy, the revived Sixties musical about "the deaf, dumb and blind kid who sure plays a mean pinball," is to close despite being nominated for eight top theatre awards.

"Houses are unpredictable with the show and it has been a bit of a battle to keep it going," said Paul Keating, who was working as a supermarket shelf stacker when he auditioned successfully for the starring role.
"We've run a year and won eight nominations. But that's the way it goes," he told reporters.
The musical, by Pete Townshend of The Who, was on Tuesday nominated for eight Laurence Olivier awards. The winners are due to be announced on February 16.
